head_height.value: At least 29mm and no more than 34mm (chin to crown), per the official dimension diagram.

file_spec.value: Image file size must be less than 2MB; image resolution should be 600×800 px.

ears_visibility.value: Hair should not cover the ears.

face_visibility.value: Hair should not cover the face.

accessories.value: "Do not use any apparel-headphone, mask etc." (verbatim NIS instruction; site copy is informally worded and the exact scope of "apparel" is not clarified elsewhere on the page — read narrowly here as headphones/masks/similar items).

ears.en: Hair should not cover the ears.
ears.ja: 髪の毛で耳を隠さないこと。

face_visibility.en: Hair should not cover the face.
face_visibility.ja: 髪の毛で顔を隠さないこと。

accessories.en: Do not wear any headphones, masks, or similar apparel/accessories in the photo.
accessories.ko: 헤드폰, 마스크 등의 장신구·의류를 착용하지 말 것.
accessories.ja: ヘッドホン、マスクなどの装身具・衣類を着用しないこと。

db_conflicts.research_value: 2.9~3.4cm (29-34mm, chin to crown) per Nigeria Immigration Service's official passport-photo dimension diagram

cross_verification.note_en: Verified directly against the live Nigeria Immigration Service 'Domestic Passport Application Portal' (passport.immigration.gov.ng/image-compliance), including its embedded dimension diagram image (assets/images/dummy.png) which was downloaded and read pixel-for-pixel to confirm the 35mm/45mm/29mm/34mm figures. Size (35×45mm = 3.5×4.5cm) matches the DB value exactly; head_height does not (see db_conflicts).
